notes.title: New Jumping System!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We can JUMP now in WarDust!

Added experimental feature "Manual jumping"

To jump effectively, follow these steps:

- Enable "Manual jumping" option in OPTIONS/GENERAL
- Begin by bending your knees slightly.
- Quickly straighten your legs, pushing off the ground with your feet.
-Your jump in real life will create a jump in game much higher.
- As you jump, use a wide range of motion to maximize your power and height.
- Remember, the faster and more explosive your movement, the stronger your jump will be. You can also use some neck movement.
- Remember2, do not skip the leg day.

Added option to turn off Auto Jump.
Both jump systems can work together.
Manual jumping doesn't work currently on FitRun locomotion.
For seating players or the ones with health issues that prevents them to jump, different simplified way should come later.

Now it's also possible to grab/catch objects when flying/jumping

Thank you!

notes.title: Doors & Windows! Interactive Objects Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The past month has seen many small performance and bug-fix updates, but also the addition of two types of interactive objects to War Dust gameplay!  Windows which break when bullets or rockets hit them, and doors which are controlled in-game by pressing buttons or grabbing knobs on the interior or exterior of buildings. There are plans for more of these types of interactive objects in War Dust, so keep an eye out for more! 


Changelog:

added breakable windows.
They are placed in various places in many maps, mostly where usually windows are 😄
To break windows you need to shoot it with your gun or with projectile (stinger, tank etc.)
Planned (no ETA) : 
breaking by driving vehicle through it, by hand punch, by weapon itself hit, by throwable items. At the moment bots won't see you through it, it will be looked after as well at some stage.

Added interactive gates and doors on some maps.

How to use them :
- to open/close the gate touch corresponding red button with your controller. Each gate have 2 buttons on each side. 
- you can't open/close the gate while it's opening/closing, you need to wait for the process to finish

-Added hundreds of interactive doors. There are 3 types, 2 wooden ones and 1 metal one. They are all rusty, rotten and squeaky 😉 
To open the door just touch the handle with your controller, it will open itself.  There is a little cooling time before you can close it or open it again (to be sure that all players received information over the network)
One thing to note : when opening the door you will be moved towards door opening direction for 1 second. This is the moment when you don't have control over your avatar.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33756506/68f68944eb4dd30babfbaeba61fbb368daab41c4.png[/img]

Hello! New WarDust update is up on steam!

Some of you probably noticed that in the last couple of days there was little update every day. 
This post collects all features added recently plus new ones today.
So let's start.

- Added 4 new leaderboards. 
1)  Lifetime scores. 
2) Monthly scores
3) Kills by knife only, monthly
4) Best killers against real players only. Amount of kills minus deaths (also from real players only) will be the score added to your stats. cleared monthly
We are not sure if this is final version, we might add different leaderboards or replace existing ones. Maybe monthly will be replaced to weekly ones. We will see. It's still getting its shape.
Your score will be uploaded to leaderboard only when there was more than 5 real players in the match. Score is synced when the match is over.
Please also note that we can detect anyone that will start to tinker with personal score to be at the top of the leaderboard. In that case perma ban will be applied for leaderboards feature. Play fair, win fair, have fun fair.
Please read the update to privacy policy agreement right at the start of the game

- Voice chat in game options will now mute your voice and others completely.

- Added possibility to mute any player in game (for example the one you don't really like  ). Simply click on his/her name on the scoreboard. You will also see there, who is muted in their personal options.

- Spectator now will be muted (edited)

- Added various stats to score board. 
1) Knife kills (total kills includes that figure). Please note that knife kills gives you 5 times more points.
2) Shot accuracy. Percentage of shots fired and shots that hit the enemy
3) Current player class icons
4) Speaker icon (muted/not muted)

- Further tweaks on spawn room and GUI

- Added experimental home base protection in Dubai (X and Y)

- Adjusted AWP collision, to prevent situations when you were not be able to shoot when gun was too close to other objects.

- Every throwable item (like frag etc.) will now be frame rate independent. That means throwing frags will always work correctly, even when your frame rate drops significantly (no more your own frag drops below your feet). Same should apply to pro loco.

- Added custom server admin panel. When you host your own server you can :
1) Send horn signal to others (for example to start league match)
2) Save finished match stats to text file. 
3) Restart map/server any time you want.
4) Kick player out 
5) Kill all players (I don't know why I added this, but maybe someone is sadist and might need it)

- Fixed Kaoh Kreik character controller bug. Issues with stairs etc. (apologize for that, I thought I fixed it last week, probably forgot to press save button)

- And cherry on the top. When player is killed with explosion, it will be thrown to the sky, screaming like a mad man

notes.title: New War Dust Released! Complete Rework and Upgrade to War Dust.
notes.content:
We are proud to present War Dust completely reworked and remastered from the ground up.  We've spent many, many months working and testing New War Dust to bring you the best possible VR experience.  Our development team has expanded to include experienced players, so New War Dust is developed by players for players.  We've focused on enhancing visuals, increasing immersion, improving performance, fixing bugs and most of the issues that were reported by users in the past couple of years.  Currently there are 12 remastered maps in Official Rotation with 10 more under development! 

New War Dust will deliver some of the most epic moments you have ever experienced in VR.  We would like to thank all the players who have helped test and suggest improvements and changes as we worked on the beta branch of the game.  Now that this new version of War Dust has become the main branch, you can still find the legacy version on a separate game branch under "betas" menu in steam.

We hope you share the excitement we feel as this unique and action-packed game is brought closer to its full potential.  We look forward to working with the active player community to continue this process of growing and evolving New War Dust even further in the future.  We have only just begun.

There are 3 powerful ways to enjoy New War Dust.  Official Rotation, Community Mods, and Community Events.  Each of these has a Discord Server to explore and deepen your War Dust Experience.

Official Rotation:  Raptor Lab Maps Completely Remastered  https://discord.gg/HbCandC 

Community Mods:  Mods created by the War Dust Community  https://discord.gg/RxWpDXMmNS 

Community Events: Tournaments on Tuesdays and Fridays, and Weekend Events  https://discord.gg/NY3fKMQ4D2 

Please keep the lines of communication open by posting on Raptor Lab Official Discord server any bugs (fighting these is an ongoing effort) or ideas for improvement as you explore this amazing game.

Invite your friends to check out New War Dust!  Let's balance the teams for more competition and fun as we welcome new players and teach them the basic mechanics of gameplay.

See you on the Battlefield!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RBchlPc78nk

Changelog:

1. Engine: Game engine upgrade to newer Unity version.
2. Performance: Optimized netcode and map build efficiency, improving load on both CPU and GPU.
3. Weapons: Completely reworked: added recoil, improved sounds, changed damage levels to better balance classes, made damage different based on what part of the body is hit, added many weapons skins
4. Remastered Maps: 12 maps in rotation with 10 more under development (including maps from 2019 that were removed from game, but will return).  New shaders and materials throughout the remastered maps with 4k textures
     Baked lighting on both day and night maps
5. Bugs: Long-reported bugs fixed such as floating buildings and rocks, missing colliders, 2-handed bug, etc. (but there will always be more)
6. Audio: More environmental 3D sounds around player
7. Vehicles: New models, better physics, and more accurate collision
8. New Features: spawnable and map-placed exploding barrels, spawnable ladders, wrist life meter, and more!
9. GUI: Completely reworked with easy to read fonts and immersive menu area with improved access to menus and game features.
10. Netcode: Upgraded with many optimizations changes made.
11. Stability: Greatly improved to allow more real players at a time in one room.  An official-rotation server room will always have 64 soldiers, but the number of real players per room has always been capped at 24(before a second room is auto-       created), but that cap has been raised from 24 to 40.
12. Bots: Behavior modified and optimized: More realistic movements across the map.  Bots now are a little slower to respond, but are more accurate and deadly when they do.
13. VFX: Increased all explosions, firepower and  environmental visual effects for better immersion.  Added more environmental effects on all maps.

We're happy to announce the release of this new update ! It brings 3 major changes to the game :

[h2]Spectator Mode[/h2]

In any type of match, players can now chose to spectate the game in the team selection screen. They then become a flying camera that can easily and rapidly move around the map. A menu is available by pressing the right controller's trigger to navigate between controls points, players or go back to the spawn menu and the left trigger can be used to accelerate.

[h2]New weapon : SIG-550[/h2]

The brand new weapon available with the assault class is unique in War Dust because it's the only weapon that shoots in burst ! This rifle used in the Swiss army is available at level 10 ! It performs wells at mid and long range but is less effective than the M4 for close range engagement.

[h2]Mod Cycle[/h2]

This feature is now fully operational. The mod cycle allows players to create a list of custom maps that will be played consecutively, each with its own configuration.
